name: SPARE
description: Measures performance of sparse-view reconstruction algorithms for 4D cone-beam CT from a one-minute scan.
evaluation_method: RMSE / SSIM / PSNR (image reconstruction quality metrics)
typical_sota_score: 0.7–0.95 SSIM (varies by task and sparsity level)
reputation: Recognized within the medical image reconstruction community for evaluating sparse-view 4D cone-beam CT methods, but niche outside that field.
notes: Specialized, modality-specific benchmark with limited data volume; requires domain expertise and access to reconstruction toolchains. Susceptible to overfitting to simulation parameters and differs between simulated and clinical scans. Not applicable to LLMs.
